# integrate new experimental tools

Try two command-line tools: [curlie](https://github.com/rs/curlie), a `curl` front end with HTTPie-like syntax and coloured output, and [gorram](https://github.com/natefinch/gorram), which exposes Go standard-library functions as shell commands (`gorram strings ToUpper …`).
